description.ncbi_summary: This gene encodes a protein that is thought to function as a transcription factor. The protein is a cancer-associated antigen that can stimulate autologous T-cell responses, and it is therefore considered to be a potential immunotherapeutic target for the treatment of various hematopoietic malignancies, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. [provided by RefSeq, May 2010].

uniprot_function.text: Functions as a suppressor of the biological clock that drives the daily circadian rhythms of cells throughout the body (PubMed:25936801). Acts as a nuclear repressor of the CLOCK-BMAL1 heterodimer-mediated transcriptional activation of the core clock components (PubMed:25936801). Inhibits circadian clock function in cancer cells, when overexpressed (PubMed:25936801).
